test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 5: Participating in a Live Class
test_cases.pre_condition: A student is currently logged in, has successfully joined a live video session, and has participated in in-session interactions (e.g., sent chat messages, requested to speak, and had intervention granted by the teacher). The video session is active and ongoing.
test_cases.expected_result: The student's video session participation is terminated. The student's session is securely ended, and they are redirected to the 'Landing Page'. All temporary authentication data is cleared, and the system notifies the user of successful logout.
test_cases.post_condition: The student is logged out of the system and redirected to the 'Landing Page'. Their session is terminated, and all temporary authentication data is cleared.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Exit' button to leave the session
